name: An installation can say who may write a lifecycle fact, who may approve and who may take the merge slot
aliases: who may record reviewed and integrated
summary: Three per-installation booleans in deployment.private.json, each absent or false meaning off, so an installation that configures nothing is unchanged. admin.py coordinator-rules status|on|off [--rule NAME] --actor OPERATOR is operator-gated, holds the deployment config lock, writes nothing when nothing changes, and appends to the bounded coordinator_rules_audit list. lifecycle_authors: the lifecycle action accepts implemented, tested and the task's lifecycle-scope only from the task's assignee or a listed operator, and reviewed, integrated, deployed, live-verified, enabled, live and a release deploy only from a listed operator; while off the write succeeds and the refusal that would apply is a WARNING on stderr. admin.py lifecycle-authors PROJECT is the read-only preview (each trusted fact, its actor, allowed/would_be_refused/reason, counts.would_be_refused, bounded by --limit). independent_approval refuses review approve from the contribution's author and the task's assignee; coordinator_writes refuses it, and merge-acquire, unless the actor is a listed operator or of a listed operator's principal. Both refuse before any native write, and nothing is migrated.
